newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia's Bank Arya rises on debut.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia's Bank Arya rises on debut.

text.p: Indonesia's Bank Arya Panduarta rose about 23 percent on its debut on Thursday on the Jakarta Stock Exchange, brokers said.

It rose to a high of 1,200 rupiah, compared with an offer price of 975 rupiah, before easing slightly to 1,175 rupiah in early morning trade. At 0300 GMT, volume was modest at about 6.5 million shares.
"It made about a 20 percent gain. It is quite good," a broker with Bomar Securities said, adding that buying interest in the market was relatively strong.
But other brokers said the potential for further upside was limited as it had already touched a high of 1,200 rupiah.
"It's a little bit expensive. At this time, investors can buy bank issues such as Bank Danamon, which already has a good track record, at a cheaper price," one local broker added.
In its prospectus, Bank Arya said it posted a net profit of 8.83 billion rupiah in 1996, against a net profit of 4.86 billion rupiah in 1995.
Bank Arya floated 98 million shares, with PT Bhakti Investama acting as lead underwriter. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
